images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame: a dim bedroom at 2 a.m., camera straight-on at desk height. Center: a 1984 walnut-veneer tabletop radio whose single large round tuning dial dominates the frame, the parchment-cream dial face backlit warm amber from within, FM numbers 88 to 108 around the rim in an old serif, a few station names, and a small red handwritten note at 98.1 marking a closed station; a thin red pointer approaching it, a chrome bezel with a soft glass reflection, and orange valve glow leaking through the speaker cloth below. Left: a rainy night window in cold blue with streaks, a white ceramic mug on the desk. Right: a dark round wall clock. Heavy vignette, film grain, warm-versus-cold lighting, intimate and lonely. Bottom: two lines of centered subtitle in a gentle serif, the DJ reading a listener letter. Korean UI text: "FM 98.1 · 새벽 두 시의 편지", "02:14".

The rest of the room sinks into deeper darkness with stronger vignette, while the rainy window stays cold blue. Subtitles at the bottom are brighter, key phrases highlighted in warm gold, as the DJ describes the listener's room exactly. Uncanny, quiet, emotional realization, film grain, warm tube light. Korean UI text: "3분 빠름", "금 간 손잡이", "02:17".
